_comment: Code points no font covers. P1: U+2192 RIGHTWARDS ARROW is absent from Roboto (the original '-> overlaps letters' report). P2: U+1D11E MUSICAL SYMBOL G CLEF is astral (surrogate pair) and absent even from the BMP-only Unifont fixture, sitting one char before a run boundary so run composition is exercised. fontkit maps both to .notdef; the engine reserves MISSING_GLYPH_FACTOR*fontSize (not the .notdef box) so the glyph preset's per-character x stays put. The glyph-box variant adds renderToSVG({ missingGlyph: 'box' }): the character is dropped and a hollow rect is drawn in the reserved slot, so painted width == measured width in every viewer. missingGlyph is a no-op for flat/browser/preserve today.
